subtitle: Groceries for the week
intro: A compact market for produce, pantry staples, and the few things you would rather not hunt for.
about: Greenmarket is one room and a back cooler. We stock what we would cook with ourselves and skip the aisles that only add noise.

offerings.title: This week's vegetables
offerings.detail: A short list from nearby farms, priced by the piece so you can shop for two or for six.

offerings.title: Milk, eggs, and butter
offerings.detail: Everyday staples from creameries we can name, kept cold and restocked each morning.

offerings.title: Oil, grain, and salt
offerings.detail: The bottles and bags that actually get used, in sizes that fit a home shelf.

offerings.title: Flowers and bread
offerings.detail: A weekend loaf and a bunch of flowers by the register, while they last.
